message.content:
This portrait-style editorial illustration features a man from the chest up, depicted in a painterly, stylized manner. He has light skin, receding brown hair, and a somber facial expression. He wears a grey short-sleeved collared shirt with epaulettes featuring two gold stars on each shoulder and a silver wing-shaped pin on his left chest.

He holds a black rectangular sign with rounded corners in front of his torso. The sign features the white printed text "DJOKO SUSILO" above larger text "D 1 BUI". His hands, with visible wrinkles and fingernails, grip the edges of the sign.

The background is a solid light grey. At the top, bold red capital letters spell "TEMPO". Above this, smaller white text on a black bar reads "NOVEL BASWEDAN: SAYA AKAN BUKA SEMUA" alongside a small photographic inset of a different man's face. Below the "TEMPO" logo is black text: "EDISI 8-14 OKTOBER 2012" and "MENGAPA POLISI KALAP". A barcode, price "RP 29.700", website "WWW.TEMPO.CO", and additional small print are in the bottom left corner.
